projects.name: Walls
projects.text: Devastation ruins one fewer building per level; Doom from a failed mandatory expedition −5 per level.

projects.name: Granary
projects.text: Famine Crises halved; Grain upkeep −20% for all.

projects.name: Great Market
projects.text: Unlocks the shops; +10 Gold per House per Year.

projects.name: Cathedral
projects.text: All Scions Sanity +25% per Year in town; Chapel slots +2 for every House; Holy +10% for all; resurrection events for all Houses.

projects.name: Rift Observatory
projects.text: Shows the expedition's event pool and boss type before departure; mandatory expeditions foreshadowed 1 Year earlier.

projects.name: Arena
projects.text: Sorties yield +50%; Sortie injuries capped at Mild.

projects.name: Aqueduct
projects.text: Disease events removed; Infirmary effects +1 level for all.

projects.name: Beacon
projects.text: Recruit arrival +25% for all; unique-Scion events more likely.

projects.name: Court of Peers
projects.text: Accord losses −25%; Unrest −10 (solo).

projects.name: University
projects.text: Every Scion in town gains JP each Year in their current Job; Study is unlimited.

projects.name: Bastion of the Gate
projects.text: The Year 20 expedition starts with a shield on every Scion and one free retreat.

projects.name: Mausoleum of the Pact
projects.text: A Relic found by any House counts for all Houses' Lore at 25%.

projects.name: Armorer
projects.text: A shop: armor and shields.

projects.name: Weaponsmith
projects.text: A shop: weapons.

projects.name: Apothecary
projects.text: A shop: consumables and cures.

projects.name: Curio Dealer
projects.text: A shop: accessories, Tarot-linked trinkets, one random magic item per Year.

projects.name: Beastmonger
projects.text: A shop: summon upgrades and pets.

projects.name: Fence
projects.text: A shop: buys loot; sells stolen goods at a discount.

projects.name: Armour of the Pact
projects.text: The Pact's armourers fit every Scion in the city. Every Scion's Durability +10% at every location, per level.

projects.name: Bonesetters' Hall
projects.text: Surgeons who have seen everything the Rift does to a body. Every Scion's injury rolls +1 step.

projects.name: The Last Rite
projects.text: A rite said over every Scion before they go. Once in each Scion's life, a blow that would kill them, or leave them a Mortal wound, takes an arm instead.

projects.name: Rift Assayers
projects.text: Assayers who can read what the Rift leaves in a blade. Per level, a 15% chance that each find, and each shop lot, comes one tier finer (never past Masterwork).

projects.name: Bell of Saviours
projects.text: A bell cast from the Rift's own glass, rung once a Year at the Reckoning. Per level, a 6% chance that each recruit who arrives is one of the Foretold: a prodigy, stronger in every stat but Speed.
